name: muscle up negative
description: A slow lowering from the top of a bar muscle-up through the transition into a hang. It teaches the path the full rep takes.
instructions: Jump or step up into the support position above the bar with straight arms.
Lower slowly into the bottom of a dip, keeping the bar close to your body.
Lean your chest forward over the bar as you pass through the transition.
Keep lowering until you are under the bar in a pull-up position.
Finish at straight arms, taking five seconds or more in total.
